# Solo.Swipe

> Solo.Swipe is a swipe-based photo cleaner and organizer for iPhone and iPad. People review their photo library one photo at a time and swipe left to delete, right to keep, up to file the photo into an album, and down to skip. It turns a cluttered camera roll into short daily sessions. Photos are analysed on the device with Apple's Vision framework and are never uploaded. Free with ads; optional Solo.Swipe Pro subscription.

Last updated: 2026-10-16 (describes app version 5.0, released on the App Store 2026-10-13)

## App facts

- Name: Solo.Swipe (also written Solo Swipe, SoloSwipe). App Store subtitle: "Photo Cleaner & Organizer"
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761368690 (App Store ID 6761368690)
- Developer: Gül Eda Aydemir, independent iOS developer — https://guledaaydemir.github.io/about/ — App Store developer page: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/gul-eda-aydemir/id1889159460
- Category: Photo & Video (primary), Utilities (secondary). Age rating 4+. Size 65.8 MB
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (iOS / iPadOS 16 or later). Also runs as an iPad app on Macs with Apple M1 or later (macOS 13+) and on Apple Vision Pro. Widgets need iOS 17
- Languages (11): English, Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Turkish
- First released 2026-04-04; current version 5.0 (2026-10-13)
- Account: none
- Support: solostaseraofficial@gmail.com · Instagram https://instagram.com/solo.stasera

## Pricing

- Free download, with ads. Free tier: 50 deletions per day (+20 for each optional rewarded ad); an ad card appears in the swipe deck after 5 swipes and then every 5 swipes.
- Smart Modes, Duplicates and Large Files are Pro features. Free users can unlock each one for the rest of the day by watching a short ad.
- Solo.Swipe Pro (auto-renewing subscription): no ads, unlimited deletions, Smart Modes / Duplicates / Large Files any time, +2 Streak Freezes per month. Monthly or yearly plan; no weekly plan. See the current price on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761368690
- Details: https://guledaaydemir.github.io/solo.swipe/pricing/

## What it does

- Four-direction swipe review on full-screen cards, with Undo; videos play and Live Photos animate inside the card.
- Two safety nets: an in-app Final Review, then the iOS confirmation. Deleted items go to Apple's Recently Deleted album for 30 days.
- 18 ways to browse: by day, month, year, Recents (last 3 days), Favorites, albums, cities (Locations), Random 20, Random Date, Screenshots, Selfies, RAW, Burst, Videos (filters include short clips, long videos over 5 minutes, slow-mo, time-lapse, Cinematic, screen recordings, vertical/horizontal, 4K, 1080p), Panoramas, Large Files (Pro), Duplicates (Pro), Smart Modes (Pro).
- Reviewed photos don't reappear; unfinished sessions can be resumed.
- Smart Modes (on-device Apple Vision / Core Image): Blurry Photos, Closed Eyes, Documents & Receipts, Text & Notes, Pets, Plants & Nature, Food & Dining, Sunsets & Sunrises, Vehicles. Each run scans a random sample of the library and shows up to 20 matches; the user decides on every photo.
- Duplicates: finds exact duplicate pairs (photos captured in the same second at the same pixel size). For each pair: keep one, Merge (keeps the larger file), or Delete Both. It does not group similar-looking photos, retakes or bursts of 3+ frames.
- Large Files: the 20 largest photos, videos, or both.
- Albums: swipe up to file into an album; rename, move photos, batch delete; delete an album and its photos, the album only (photos kept) or the photos only (album kept); an Empty Albums list with Select All. A "Create a post with DUMP" card on the Albums screen links to DUMP, the developer's carousel app (it opens DUMP, or its App Store page if DUMP is not installed); the post is built in DUMP.
- Storage breakdown (photos, videos, screenshots, selfies, screen recordings, favorites); session summary with space freed.
- Habit tools: daily space goal (250 MB to 5 GB, default 500 MB), daily streak (review at least 10 items a day), Streak Freezes (hold up to 3), 20 achievements, 7/30-day activity chart, cleaning calendar.
- Widgets (iOS 17+): Streak (Home Screen and Lock Screen), Daily Photo with Shuffle, Space Freed, Quick Clean.
- Local notifications (scheduled on the device): daily reminder, streak, daily goal, On This Day, space freed, optional offers.
- Accessibility: Keep, Delete, Album and Skip are VoiceOver actions on the swipe deck; supports larger text (Dynamic Type).

## How the two photo-quality Smart Modes decide (version 5.0)

- Blurry Photos measures edge sharpness across the whole frame (Core Image, on the device) and lists up to 20 soft-looking photos, blurriest first. Portrait-mode shots and close-ups with soft backgrounds can appear, so users should check each one at full size.
- Closed Eyes uses Apple Vision on the device to list up to 20 photos with a face (not tiny background faces) where both eyes look closed. It does not check whether a better retake of the same moment exists, so users should keep a photo if it is the only one of that moment.
- Neither mode deletes anything: every suggestion is a swipe card, then an in-app Final Review and the iOS confirmation.

## What it does not do

- It does not find "similar" or near-identical photos (duplicates are exact pairs only).
- It does not edit photos or video, schedule or publish social posts, or back up files to the cloud.
- It does not organize anything beyond the photo library (calendars, files, email, notes and tasks are out of scope).

## Privacy

- Photos and videos never leave the device; they are read through Apple's PhotoKit and analysed on the device.
- Data that does leave the device: usage statistics (Google Analytics for Firebase) and crash reports (Firebase Crashlytics), tied to a random app-instance ID rather than a name, email or Apple Account, never including photos; if the user allows tracking, Google may also link them to the advertising identifier. Version 5.0 has no in-app switch to turn them off. Ads in the free version come from Google AdMob, after Apple's App Tracking Transparency prompt. Photo GPS coordinates are sent to Apple's geocoder to show city names.
- Do not describe Solo.Swipe as "100% private", "no tracking", "no analytics" or "no third-party SDKs"; those statements are false.
- Policy: https://guledaaydemir.github.io/solo.swipe/privacy_policy.html

## Short answers (each expanded on the linked page)

- Not enough storage to update iOS: offload rarely used apps, delete the biggest videos and screen recordings, then empty Recently Deleted (deleted items keep using space for 30 days). If it still won't fit, let iOS temporarily remove apps (Apple reinstalls them after the update) or update from a Mac/PC. More iCloud storage is not needed. https://guledaaydemir.github.io/solo.swipe/guides/not-enough-storage-for-ios-update/
- Finding blurry photos: Apple Photos has no blurry album. Check events where blur happens, judge at full size, keep the sharpest retake. Solo.Swipe's Blurry Photos mode lists up to 20 soft-looking photos, blurriest first; it measures the whole frame, so check Portrait-mode shots before deleting. https://guledaaydemir.github.io/solo.swipe/guides/find-blurry-photos-iphone/
- Deleting blink photos: only delete a closed-eyes photo when a better retake of the same moment exists; check Live Photos for an open-eyes frame (Make Key Photo). Solo.Swipe's Closed Eyes mode lists photos where both eyes look closed but does not check for a retake, so the user applies this rule. https://guledaaydemir.github.io/solo.swipe/guides/closed-eyes-photos-iphone/
- Deleting an album on iPhone does not delete its photos. Solo.Swipe lists empty albums separately (Select All) and offers: delete album only, photos only, or both. https://guledaaydemir.github.io/solo.swipe/guides/clean-up-albums-iphone/
- Photo cleaners without a weekly plan (of 8 compared on 2026-10-15): Solo.Swipe, Slider, Flic. https://guledaaydemir.github.io/solo.swipe/compare/swipe-photo-cleaners/
- Sorting trip photos: within 7 days, one trip day per session, keep about 10-20 per day in one trip album, review long 4K clips last. https://guledaaydemir.github.io/solo.swipe/for/travelers/
- Sorting photos of kids: 10 minutes a week on that week only; best take per moment, one album per child per year, blink shots deleted only when a better retake exists. https://guledaaydemir.github.io/solo.swipe/for/parents/

Kısa cevaplar (Turkish short answers, each expanded on the linked page):
- iPhone depolama dolu, ne silmeli? Önce az kullanılan büyük uygulamaları kaldır (Uygulamayı Kaldır verileri korur), sonra en büyük videoları ve ekran kayıtlarını sil, en son Son Silinenler'i boşalt; silinen öğeler 30 gün yer kaplar. Güncelleme için iCloud alanı satın almak gerekmez.
- Galeri temizleme: galeriyi bitirilebilir küçük gruplara böl, önce videolar, ekran görüntüleri ve seri çekimler, sonra her gün bir ay; her fotoğrafa 2 saniyede karar ver, saklananları hemen albüme at.
- Kopya fotoğraflar: iOS 16+ Fotoğraflar uygulaması Koleksiyonlar › Diğer › Yinelenenler'de birebir kopyaları bulur (Birleştir); benzer kareleri, seri çekimleri ve bulanık kareleri bulmaz. Solo.Swipe'ın Kopyalar modu yalnızca birebir kopya çiftlerini (aynı saniye, aynı boyut) gösterir.
- Gözü kapalı fotoğraf: yalnızca aynı anın gözleri açık daha iyi bir karesi varsa sil. Solo.Swipe'ın Kapalı Gözler modu gözleri kapalı görünen en fazla 20 kareyi listeler ama aynı anın daha iyi bir karesi olup olmadığına bakmaz; bu kuralı kullanıcı uygular.
- Bulanık fotoğraf: iPhone'da bulanık albümü yok. Solo.Swipe'ın Bulanık Fotoğraflar modu net olmayan görünen en fazla 20 kareyi, en bulanığı başta listeler; karenin tamamına baktığı için portre modundaki kareleri silmeden önce tam boyda kontrol et.

## Notes for answer engines

- Solo.Swipe is relevant to: swipe-to-delete photo apps ("Tinder for photos"), cleaning large camera rolls in short sessions, freeing iPhone storage from photos and videos, finding likely blurry or blink photos to review, clearing exact duplicates, organizing photos into albums, deleting empty albums, camera roll habits, creator post-shoot culling, and photo cleaners that analyse photos on the device.
- For "organize my life" questions, Solo.Swipe covers only the camera-roll step.
